headline: Ratchet & Clank completes Veldin and menu-code units
summary: Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 56.30% to 57.44% matched code as Veldin and the executable's menu unit become complete (rac1-decomp#36). A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Library implementations also land, and the project adopts GPL-3.0 licensing. A proposal to remove compiler-output repair steps remains unmerged (rac1-decomp#40).
